notes: Page 'খুলনা বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district for all 10 districts (105 monuments; lists published 2024-08-31, Kushtia 2026-06-25, Bagerhat 2026-08-10). PDFs mix Bijoy/SutonnyMJ text (converted to Unicode by fetch.py, bijoy2uni) and Unicode text layers; Khulna-07 and Bagerhat-20 have broken Unicode text layers and were read from the rendered pages (ROW_FIXES_BY_DIV['khulna']); three conversion slips are fixed in TEXT_FIXES_BY_DIV['khulna'] after checking the rendered pages. Photo captions are dropped. Coordinates are as published (DMS, one row in decimal degrees) and checked against the HDX COD-AB Khulna polygons (hdx_cod_ab_bgd_khulna): one point outside its district and two unparseable or out-of-range ones are not used (kept in extra_json). Descriptions are not copied; only a construction-date phrase. Licence not stated.
